titolo
This is the Sparkling Tones pedal.
accende
Switch it on, and it finds your Spark by itself, over Bluetooth. Your phone can stay in your pocket.
quattro
Four footswitches, four sounds. The display shows what's playing, and the light above the switch turns on: red for half A.
meta
The fifth switch flips to half B, and the lights turn green. The sound only changes when you pick one.
banchi
The two bank buttons scroll through your banks: the amp's own presets, and up to eight banks of your own.
ponte
You build your banks in the app. Hold both bank buttons, and the pedal opens a bridge to your phone: send a bank, and it's in.
looper

Hold the fifth switch for three seconds, and it becomes a looper. With the loop empty, the bank buttons set its length: one to sixteen bars, or free. In free length, you close the loop whenever you like.
cambio

And this is the important part. Record the rhythm with one preset, then hold the fifth switch: you are back to your presets, and the loop keeps playing. Pick a lead sound, and hold the fifth switch again to go back to the looper.
overdub
Now overdub: the second part goes on top of the first, with the new sound. Rhythm and lead, from one pedal.
fine
It runs on a battery, and you can build it yourself: the guide is free, step by step.
finale
Sparkling Tones: your Spark, under your feet.
